title: Meeting Of Communists Held At 76 Mokanshan Road

Subject (in full) Meeting of Communists held at 76 Mokanshan Road.

Made by D. I. Ross. CCP Forwarded by O.B. Kim / 0.1

In continuation of a previous report of July 2, Secret
Agent Ma Lieu Wei, Western District, reports that between
8 and 10 p.m. July 3, 6 members of the local Communist Party
in the Western District held a meeting at No. 76 Mokanshan
Road. Tsoh Yeng Sung (祝英生), member of the Central Committee
presided. The meeting decided to instruct members of the C.Y.
Group to instigate factory and mill workers in the Western
District to declare a strike on July 7 and participate in a
demonstration which will be staged during the evening of that
day at Oo Koh Zang, Jessfield (Bubbling well and Gordon Road
District) to commemorate the execution of Shiang Tsoong Fah,
one of the leaders of the Communist Party, by Chinese Military
Authorities on June 23, 1931

During the course of the proceedings the chairman also
reported the recent developments of the Red Army in Kiangsi,
Kwangtung, Hunan and other provinces.

Agent states that No. 76 Mokanshan Road is not a regular
meeting place.

D.I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Subject (in full) Members of local Communist Party reported to be planning
to hold meeting.

Made by D. I. Ross Forwarded by D. I. Ross

Secret Agent Ma Lien-wei (馬建忠), operating in
the western district, reports that he has received information
to the effect that members of the local Communist Party are
planning to hold a meeting at No.76 Mokanshan Road between
9 and 10 p.m. July 3.

Discreet enquiries made by C.D.S.I. Pan Lien-pih
show that this address is a Chinese dwelling and is occupied
by five or six factory workers together with their families.

D. I. Ross
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
